newsitem.title: FINLAND: LORD MOYNE SURPRISED BY AMER REDEMPTION.
newsitem.headline: LORD MOYNE SURPRISED BY AMER REDEMPTION.

text.p: British investor Jonathan Bryan Guinness, third Lord Moyne, said on Thursday he was surprised by Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy's redemption this week of shares offered to him by one of four big holders of the vote-heavy K series.
"I am naturally disappointed. I am also somewhat surprised," Lord Moyne said in a statement, which did not say whether he planned to take any action.
Amer's board decided on Tuesday to exercise its right to redeem for 75.3 million markka the 275,000 K shares offered to Lord Moyne.
Guinness said it was a "strange" decision by a loss-making company to use 75 million markka of unrestricted equity for the redemption.
He had offered 273.64 markka per share -- much more than the price of the listed A series.
Three other Finnish institutions, who had also agreed to sell K shares to Guinness, later reneged, citing insufficient guarantees.
The Briton said he did not believe that the delay with the guarantees had been the real reason for the other K shareholders to pull out, but did not say what reasons they may have had.
